greedy.raw_logits_source: generate(output_logits=True) float32 step logits, cross-checked bitwise against the pass-through recorder

sampler.batch: one unpadded batch of G identical prompts

generation_contract.sampler_semantics: transformers 4.57.1 generation/utils.py. _get_logits_processor adds RepetitionPenaltyLogitsProcessor iff repetition_penalty is not None and != 1.0 (L1141), and, only when do_sample, TemperatureLogitsWarper iff temperature is not None and != 1.0 (L1266), TopKLogitsWarper iff top_k is not None and != 0 (L1268), TopPLogitsWarper iff top_p is not None and < 1.0 (L1272); min_p None, typical_p 1.0 and epsilon/eta cutoffs 0.0 add nothing. top_k=0 therefore disables top-k; omitting it leaves GenerationConfig's global default top_k=50 (configuration_utils.py L357), a live top-50 truncation. When a GenerationConfig object is passed with use_model_defaults=None and the model generation config is from >= 4.50, every field equal to the global default (temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0) is replaced by the model generation config value (L1761-1783); the Supa generation_config.json holds temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, so this module always passes use_model_defaults=False with a complete config. _sample stores output_logits as the float32 copy of outputs.logits[:, -1] BEFORE the processors (L2800, L2810), then samples torch.multinomial(softmax(processed scores), num_samples=1) with no generator argument (L2828-2829); greedy is torch.argmax(processed scores). With the processor list reduced to the pass-through recorder, processed scores are the raw logits, so the sampling distribution is the raw policy softmax; this is checked per token by replay, not assumed.
generation_contract.seed_path: transformers 4.57.1 _sample passes no generator to torch.multinomial, so the draw consumes the default generator of the device holding the logits. Per call, inside torch.random.fork_rng (devices=[] on CPU, [index] on CUDA, so the caller's RNG state is restored afterwards), that default generator is seeded with the integer seed: torch.default_generator.manual_seed(seed) on CPU, torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed) under torch.cuda.device(index) on CUDA. No other RNG consumer runs during generate (eval mode is required). A separate torch.Generator(device) seeded with the same integer replays softmax(raw logits) -> torch.multinomial(., 1, generator=replay) at every step, and every sampled token of every sequence must equal its replay draw.

inputs.plan_rule: CALIBRATION core rows of R, then S, then P; within a skill sorted by id
inputs.sample_seed_rule: C13: the G samples of a prompt are G sequential single-sample calls; sample k is seeded with int(sha256('COMP-RS-001-S0-COMP|' + id + '|' + k).hexdigest()[:16], 16) mod 2**63

note: Source competence: every sampled attempt kept, no refill; rewards via the strict path.
pass_at_k_rule: pass@1 = successes / (prompts x G), the mean over all samples; pass@G = mean over prompts of maxrl.pass_at_k(G, c, G), i.e. the share of prompts with at least one success among their own G samples (n = k = G, not an extrapolation to other budgets)
response_rule: Strict body. For stop_reason 'eos' the completion must hold exactly one EOS (151645 or 151643), as its last token, and the body is the completion without it; for 'length' the completion holds no EOS and the body is the whole completion. response = tokenizer.decode(body, skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False): a special token inside the body keeps its text (e.g. <think>), so corpus.reward's strict_json fails on it. An ID the tokenizer cannot render (>= len(tokenizer)), which decode would drop silently, is rendered as '<|unrenderable:ID|>'. The body's runs of renderable IDs are decoded separately. Malformed extra content is therefore never stripped into a success. lenient_response = decode(completion, skip_special_tokens=True), the lenient rule superseded by C11, is recorded only where it differs from response; in S0-C, lenient_reward = corpus.reward(row, lenient_response) is recorded with it. Both are diagnostic only.

rule.rule: STOP_NO_SIGNAL iff the mixed-group fraction of R or S is < m_min (P recorded, not gated)
rule.s1_order_rule: section 12: the skill with the lower mixed-group fraction trains first (tie: R)

decision.rule: fits iff no OOM and max_memory_reserved <= 0.95 x cap (cap = 0.78 x total VRAM), over a completed pilot with >= 1 update; A fits -> ADOPT_A, else RERUN_WITH_B; B fits -> ADOPT_B, else STOP_HOST_INFEASIBLE; STOP_HOST_INFEASIBLE if peak worker RSS + 1.0 GiB > free RAM at launch

inventory.name: PENDING
inventory.rule: C12: UNMEASURED_NO_UPDATE defers the inventory decision to after S0-C

sampler.rule: identical in every row except effective_config.max_length = prompt tokens + max_new_tokens

canary_receipt.independent_path: maxrl_composable_skills_v2.verifier.score and maxrl_verifiable_data_v1.verifier.score, called directly per row
canary_receipt.run_meta_rule: sha256 of fixed labels: no model, tokenizer or decoding was involved

d_lookup_blind.reason: no scoped rows for this check

scoring.rule: one batch per sample index k through canary.score_with_canary (section 8.5); every per-completion strict/content/normalization/subtype record equals the journal

tokenizer_sha256_rule: tokenizer_sha256 = sha256 of the bytes of evidence/Q1_TOKENIZER_PROMPT_LENGTHS.json (s0_runtime.TOKENIZER_RECEIPT_SHA). That receipt binds the chat-template sha, the tokenizer class, max length, the special and EOS/PAD IDs, and asset_receipt_sha256, which binds the six tokenizer asset file hashes. s0_runtime.load_tokenizer(asset_receipt=...) checks all of them.
